Definition
[Continuous interpolation (Definition 35.22)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0314 1. ch35:35.22\group Maximal Regularity

For Banach spaces $B_1\subset B_0$ and $0<\theta <1$, $(B_0,B_1)_\theta $ consists of those $x=y_n+z_n$ with $\| y_n\| _{B_0}=o(2^{-n\theta })$ and $\| z_n\| _{B_1}=o(2^{n(1-\theta )})$; its norm is the corresponding infimum of $\sup _n\max (2^{n\theta }\| y_n\| ,2^{-n(1-\theta )}\| z_n\| )$.
